description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Yosei, adding {C}{C}.
Yomiji, Yosei and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Yomiji trigger, returning Yosei from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Yosei trigger, causing target player to skip their next untap step and tapping up to five target permanents that player controls.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Yosei onto the battlefield from your hand and attaching Deathrender to it.
Repeat.
